texts.zh: 我们成功骇进了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的网络系统，并获取了他们数据库的权限一段时间。然后我们的权限就突然中断了——显然，我们的骇客行为被发现了。尽管我们利用权限进行操作没有持续多久，我们依然对大批量的数据进行了拷贝并且希望——它不仅能帮助我们迅速破解对方的语言，也能评估对方的科技水准。我们只能希望不要因为玩了这个小把戏，对方就把我们当作危险的敌人。
texts.en: We were successfully able to hack into the network systems of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] and gained access to their databanks for a time, before our access was abruptly cut off - evidently, our presence did not go undetected. Although our period of access was brief, we were able to make copies of a considerable body of data that should - hopefully - help us not only swiftly translate their language but also assess their technological level. We can only hope that we haven't made ourselves dangerous enemies with this ploy...

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的团队报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一不友好的行为让相当多位于[Root.Owner.GetName]的人表示了担忧，认为[From.Owner.GetName]可能会造成威胁。
texts.en: Our team in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This unfriendly act has left many within the [Root.Owner.GetName] deeply worried at the threat the [From.Owner.GetName] may pose.

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的子个体报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限，接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。我们会紧盯着他们，他们在未来做出任何对[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]有损的事情，我们都能在第一时间注意到。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our computer systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. We should be watchful of them, and be wary of any future moves they may make that could be detrimental to the [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName].

texts.zh: 我们负责研究[From.Owner.GetName]的无人机报告了令人警觉的消息：他们试图骇入我们的电脑系统，但是被发现了！不幸的是，在我们切断他们权限之前，他们已经获得权限接触了体量相当庞大的敏感信息。这一偶然事件督促我们应当尽快更新防御协议和机动系统防火墙——同时也不要忘了上调[From.Owner.GetName]的威胁等级。
texts.en: Our drones in charge of researching the [From.Owner.GetName] report alarming news: an attempt by them to hack into our systems has been detected! Unfortunately, it seems that they gained access to a considerable amount of sensitive information before we were able to shut off their access. This occurrence has prompted us to update our defense protocols and mobile systems' firmware - and to upgrade our threat rating of the [From.Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 我们要小心点盯着他们。
label.en: We will have to be watchful of them.
